A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of the same DeRIS work, with matching methods and core experiments. v1 includes Appendices A-F; the supplied v2 ends after the references. This identifiable document omission is not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation experiments, architectural ablations, efficiency measurements and qualitative analyses, including supplementary video-dataset results.

after.justification: v2 retains original DeRIS results on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg and gRefCOCO, together with main-text ablations and training analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1-3.4 retain the same perception and cognition branches, loopback interactions, non-referent sample conversion, losses and inference threshold. Omitted supplementary explanations do not establish a change to the algorithm.

E1.justification: The four image benchmarks remain, but v2 omits the zero-shot Ref-YouTube-VOS and MeVIS evaluations from v1 Appendix E.6 and Table 12. This removes the entire reported extension to video data.

E2.justification: Table 1 drops ReLA and LAVT, while Table 2 drops CGFormer, although these methods remain in other comparisons. Appendix F.1's qualitative comparison with CRIS and LAVT also disappears. Most main-table comparator coverage remains.

E3.justification: v2 omits the supplementary zero-shot video protocol, which used no temporal information and reported J, F and J&F. No revised settings are stated for retained image experiments. Missing training specifications represent lost documentation rather than evidence that those experiments changed.

E4.justification: v2 removes the loopback-round and query-count sweeps, non-referent feature-source comparison, decoder weight-sharing ablation and detailed efficiency analysis from Appendix E.1-E.5. Appendix F's NSC, instance-mask and textual-condition case studies also disappear, substantially reducing diagnostic evidence despite retained main-text ablations.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. The retained training-stability curves show variation across epochs, not statistical uncertainty across runs.

E6.justification: Retained main-table scores are unchanged, but baseline result rows and substantial supplementary quantitative and qualitative evidence disappear. Removed results include Table 10's gIoU of 68.65 with shared versus 70.24 with independent decoder weights, and Table 12's DeRIS-L J&F of 65.1 on Ref-YouTube-VOS and 52.4 on MeVIS.

T1.justification: The displayed method equations (1)-(8) are unchanged, with no revised assumptions, proofs or mathematical reasoning. Omitted Appendix D.1 merely expands standard Jaccard and cosine formulas and restates their average already defined in Equation (6).

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about cognition as the principal bottleneck, complementary perception and cognition, loopback synergy, non-referent augmentation and state-of-the-art image segmentation performance.

C2.justification: The omitted appendices remove substantive explanations linking excessive queries to matching ambiguity, query-feature superiority to spatial perception, and independent decoder weights to reduced representation coupling. They also remove recurrence-efficiency tradeoffs, detailed NSC error interpretations and the video-applicability discussion qualified by the absence of temporal information. Main-text interpretations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Removing Appendices A-C loses mixed-dataset training information, optimizers, learning-rate schedules, batch sizes, task-specific query counts and text lengths, GPU configuration and LoRA settings. These are substantial reproducibility losses, not demonstrated changes in implementation. The abstract's shortened hyperlink still targets the same repository.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds citations to Improving Generalized Visual Grounding with Instance-Aware Joint Learning and PropVG. References supporting the omitted supplement, including MeVIS, GREC, Adam, AdamW and URVOS, disappear. The broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 removes the complete A-F supplementary structure and explanatory narrative while retaining dangling references to Appendices C, D.1 and F. The main prose otherwise changes little; smaller edits update author information, correct affiliation spellings and introduce the duplicated word 'Enhanced' in the title.

P2.justification: Supplementary Figures 7-14 and Tables 9-12 disappear, removing diagnostic plots, efficiency tables and extensive segmentation panels. Tables 1-2 shrink through row removals, Figure 3 moves between columns, and the main pages reflow. Retained figure content is otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: As supplied, v2 substantially weakens reproducibility and support for architectural choices by removing detailed training instructions, supplementary ablations and qualitative analyses while still referring readers to them. The retained method and headline results remain intact, but limited citation and editorial updates do not compensate for these important losses.
